trigger.description: Create a service to handle webhook events from QuickBooks

metadata.label: Event Channel
metadata.description: The type of QuickBooks entity event to listen for

section.label: Listener
section.description: Attach the service to a new or existing QuickBooks webhook listener.

createNew.label: Create New Listener
createNew.description: Define a new QuickBooks webhook listener in the project.

useExisting.label: Use Existing Listener
useExisting.description: Attach to a QuickBooks listener already declared in the project.

existingListener.label: Listener
existingListener.description: Select an existing listener to attach the service to.

metadata.label: Listener Name
metadata.description: Provide a name for the listener being created

metadata.label: Webhook Listener Port
metadata.description: The port on which the webhook listener accepts incoming HTTP requests

metadata.label: Webhook Secret
metadata.description: Secret used to validate incoming QuickBooks webhook requests
